description: List the available values for one portfolio filter—such as accounts, wallets, assets, transaction status, or warnings—before building a filtered query.

inputSchema.description: Flattened filter options request schema for all registered filter providers.

filter.description: Human-readable Portfolio Transactions filter expression. Only for filterName portfolio-transaction-status-counts.

mode.description: Address side to inspect for portfolio-transaction-addresses. Required for address filters. Use from for source addresses and to for destination addresses. Only for filterName portfolio-transaction-addresses; required for each.

pageSize.description: Requested number of resources to return. Oversized values are clamped to the route limit. Not for filterName accounts.

pageToken.description: Opaque token returned by the previous list response. Not for filterName accounts.

portfolioRef.description: Portfolio name or slug inside that workspace. Call list_portfolios to resolve it.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive text search applied by the provider to labels, addresses, names, or other provider-owned searchable fields. Not for filterName accounts.

anyOf.description: Stable option value that is already selected in the FilterBar. Example: from:eth-mainnet:0xabc.

items.description: Stable option value that is already selected in the FilterBar. Example: from:eth-mainnet:0xabc.

selected.description: Already-selected option values for selected-value hydration from URL filter state. A single HTTP query value is accepted as a one-element array. Not for filterName accounts.

workspaceRef.description: Workspace name or slug. Call list_workspaces to resolve it.

name: get_filter_options
title: Get Filter Options
